# prov-form-b — FIXTURE (provenance-survival)

Case **P7-B** — the UNSOURCED form with its mandatory `rationale:` sibling.

Mode B is the SHIP-WITH-FLAG path, and the label is the machine-readable carrier
of a genuine gap: Stage 9 surfaces the flag for operator awareness and the
pipeline does not silently proceed. A drop on this path severs the only route by
which the unsourced-domain warning reaches the operator gate, which is why the
presence limb matters most here.

Paired with `prov-form-b-no-rationale.md`, this is the both-arms pair for the
rationale limb: same form, the only difference is the companion field.
